text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans",
    "Open-source nature provides transparency and community trust",
    "Strong security features with end-to-end encryption and zero-knowledge architecture",
    "Excellent cross-platform availability and browser integration",
    "Reliable synchronization across all devices",
    "Option for self-hosting for ultimate data control"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to some competitors",
    "Learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup",
    "Mobile app experience, while functional, can sometimes be less intuitive than desktop",
    "Customer support for free users is primarily community-driven",
    "Some niche integrations or advanced enterprise reporting features may be less robust",
    "Organization management can feel somewhat separate from personal vault usage"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Cons: 'Organization management can feel somewhat separate from personal vault usage' replaced 'Occasional minor performance hiccups or autofill inconsistencies' because the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed' directly describes a separation in the user experience for organization management."
  ]
}

pros: Generous free tier and highly affordable premium plans
Open-source nature provides transparency and community trust
Strong security features with end-to-end encryption and zero-knowledge architecture
Excellent cross-platform availability and browser integration
Option for self-hosting for ultimate data control
cons: User interface (UI) can feel less polished or modern compared to some competitors
Learning curve for advanced features or self-hosting setup
Mobile app experience, while functional, can sometimes be less intuitive than desktop
Customer support for free users is primarily community-driven
Some niche integrations or advanced enterprise reporting features may be less robust
Organization management can feel somewhat separate from personal vault usage
changed: Cons: 'Organization management can feel somewhat separate from personal vault usage' replaced 'Occasional minor performance hiccups or autofill inconsistencies' because the note '[friction] After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed' directly describes a separation in the user experience for organization management.
